description: High-fidelity forensic dashboard of Victorian water supply proportions.
methodology: Structural Pivot: Implemented a reversed-stacking 100% area gauge where alternative sources (Desal, Groundwater, Recycled) expand from the left to physically 'push back' surface water reliance. Temporal Filtering: Data is capped at 2021 to preserve the narrative integrity of the structural shift, excluding the 2022 outlier wet year. Emphasis Engineering: Integrated a chromatic background shift that triggers at the 2018 threshold, changing background text from Blue to Amber to signal the transition to an engineered supply era. H-Sync Architecture: Uses horizontal concatenation to sync a massive 950px morphing bar with a live-updating numeric data panel.
citation: Victorian State Government. (2026). Victorian Water Accounts: Total use by resource. Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action.
